scope: Private GoLocal connector prototype for the founder's own agent and synthetic business account. No production bookings or demand evidence.

sources.finding: Muse offers a private Custom Connector path guided from chat and a Secure Credentials Store. Retrieved via Parallel Fetch after the web reader timed out.
Public connector review is separate; requires documented tools, test access, security and complete supported workflows.
Dots can use supported installed/enabled plugins, subject to permissions and execution environment.
Official SDK and Streamable HTTP tool implementation guidance; authorization and meaningful annotations required.
Separate developer and business accounts; developer testing signup offers a 90-day testing window. GraphiQL token is short-lived and reauthorization invalidates previous refresh tokens.
OAuth authorization code, state, S256 PKCE, secret exchange, account identity and refresh rotation are documented.
Documented fixed clientCreate example used as the first controlled write. Live verification pending business account.
2026-09-25 listed as active version and pinned in this pilot. Verify the authorized schema before scheduling implementation.
Use internal testing; coordinate with Jobber before testing with existing customers or broad distribution.
Housecall Pro API requires MAX; eligible admins generate read-only or full-access keys.
Advertises a no-card 14-day trial with MAX features; actual trial API-key entitlement has not been tested.
Standard no-card 14-day trial on Grow; shorter fallback to investigate after developer signup failure.
Standard signup offers Start with Google and Start with Apple. Google signup was opened for user handoff; account creation not confirmed.

observations: User authorized account creation, selected pulkitwalia099@gmail.com, and approved saving a private app with Clients read/write and Jobs read-only scopes.
User completed Developer Center signup. GoLocal Connector Test app saved; generated credentials copied directly from visible credential fields to private local .env without disclosure in chat.
Business developer signup returned An unexpected error occurred in the in-app browser; user also reported failure with another email and in Chrome.
Analytics errors were observed in the signup page console; they do not establish causation for the signup failure.
Standard free trial with Google signup opened as a fallback. No paid plan or billing information was submitted.

16 automated tests passed; Jobber HTTP responses were mocked. Real MCP SDK smoke completed search, availability, quote, approval, simulated booking, duplicate retry, status and cancellation over public HTTPS.
Temporary ngrok tunnel uses inspect=false. MCP and REST endpoints require a dedicated private bearer token; operator actions use a separate credential.
Actual Muse calls, Dots installation, live Jobber data reads/writes, appointment scheduling, fulfillment and payments are unverified.
User reports standard Jobber Google signup also fails.
User chose Housecall Pro free trial instead of sending Jobber support email; email remains unsent.
Housecall Pro signup reached required mobile-number step after entering approved email and name. User handoff pending for remaining signup, password and terms.

Official API documentation read through browser: merchant API keys use Authorization: Token; OAuth reserved for approved integration partners; GET /company supplies company identity, GET /jobs supports page_size=10.
Read-only Housecall adapter added with exact company binding, endpoint allowlist, GET-only requests, redirect refusal, sanitized errors and no customer contact fields.
21 tests passed, including five Housecall mocked-response tests. Running endpoint stays in demo mode. Trial API-key access and all live vendor operations remain unverified.
